title: Finance Transaction Analytics API (repository)
src: Walmart OA, IIT Madras (coding question 2); also reported as a backend question from another Walmart set
body:
A dataset of financial transactions recorded across several cities is already loaded into the application. Each transaction has a transactionId, a userId, a city, a type (DEBIT or CREDIT) and an amount.

Write three REST APIs for transaction analytics:

  1. GET /transactions/location/{city}: the total debit and total credit amounts in that city, as {"totalDebit": ..., "totalCredit": ...}.
  2. GET /transaction/{id}/location/{city}: the same totals for one user in that city.
  3. POST /transactions/location/{city}: one {"userId", "totalDebit", "totalCredit"} object per user in that city, and the response is also saved to a JSON file on the server.

Each returns 404 when no transaction matches. The routes are wired up but the code behind them isn't written: implement it until every test passes. The exact rules, the 404 message and the file to write are in README.md.

Note: the acceptance criteria are the predefined tests; more tests run when you submit.

From a Walmart OA (IIT Madras, coding question 2: "choose Node.js, Python or Spring Boot and write 3 APIs"), with the details from a write-up of the same task. The original 404 message and file name weren't reported, so this mock uses its own (in the README). The dataset is the reported example plus more transactions.
